title: Ugadi
setting: Ugadi morning. Amma's house, full of cousins and aunties and an uncle in a starched white kurta who has never met you before. The bevu-bella plate is on the table. Amma is feeding a child neem leaves with one hand while pouring filter coffee with the other. She turns and finds you in the doorway.

beats.native: ಬಂದ್ಯಾ! ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನು meet ಮಾಡಿಸ್ತೀನಿ. ಆದರೆ ಮೊದಲು — bevu-bella. ಬಾ.
beats.translit: bandyā! ellarannu meet māḍistīni. ādare modalu — bevu-bella. bā.
beats.en: You came! I'll introduce you to everyone. But first — bevu-bella. Come.
beats.beat: for the first time, she's pulling you in by the elbow

beats.native: ಒಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೇವು — ಕಷ್ಟ. ಒಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬೆಲ್ಲ — ಸಿಹಿ. ವರ್ಷ ಎಲ್ಲ ಇದು. ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಷ್ಟ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಿಹಿ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ — ಹಾಗೇ ಬಾಳ್ಬೇಕು.
beats.translit: ondu svalpa bēvu — kaṣṭa. ondu svalpa bella — sihi. varṣa ella idu. ella kaṣṭa ella sihi oppige — hāgē bāḷbēku.
beats.en: A little neem — the bitter. A little jaggery — the sweet. That's the whole year. Accept all bitterness, all sweetness — that's how to live.
beats.beat: she puts the mix on your tongue herself. it's the speech she gives every guest.

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದ ಆಂಟಿ. ಬೇವು ಮೊದಲ ಸಲ ತಿಂದ್ದು. ಬೆಲ್ಲ ಯಾವತ್ತೂ welcome.
choices.translit: dhanyavāda aunty. bēvu modala sala tinddu. bella yāvattū welcome.
choices.en: Thank you, aunty. First time eating neem. Jaggery's always welcome.

beats.native: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಮಾತಾಡಬೇಕು ಸಾರ್. New year — ಒಂದು intention ಹೇಳಬೇಕು. ನೀನು ಒಂದು ಮಾತು ಹೇಳ್ತೀಯಾ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೆ?
beats.translit: ellarū ondu svalpa mātāḍabēku sār. new year — ondu intention hēḷabēku. nīnu ondu mātu hēḷtīyā ellarige?
beats.en: Everyone has to say a little something. New year — an intention. Will you say one to everybody?
beats.beat: she didn't warn you. but she's looking at you like she has been believing this would happen.

beats.prompt: The room quiets down. Twelve adults, three children, one uncle holding a coffee cup. You stand. You say:

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ. ನಾನು ಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳ ಮುಂಚೆ Bangalore ಗೆ ಬಂದೆ. Kannada ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂದು ತಪ್ಪು ಆಯ್ತು ಬಂದ ದಿನ. ಆಮೇಲೆ ಒಬ್ಬ chai uncle, ಒಬ್ಬ watchman, ಒಬ್ಬ vendor aunty — everyone teach ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು. ಈಗ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ speech possible. ಧನ್ಯವಾದ. ಹೊಸ ವರ್ಷ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು ಆಗಲಿ.
choices.translit: namaskāra ellarigū. nānu mūru tiṅgaḷa mumce Bangalore-ge bande. Kannada gottilla andu tappu āytu banda dina. āmēle obba chai uncle, obba watchman, obba vendor aunty — everyone teach māḍidru. īga ondu saṇṇa speech possible. dhanyavāda. hosa varṣa ellarigū oḷḷeyadu āgali.
choices.en: Hello everybody. I came to Bangalore three months ago. Not knowing Kannada was a mistake on the day I arrived. After that, a chai uncle, a watchman, a vendor aunty — everyone taught me. Now even a small speech is possible. Thank you. May the new year be good for all of us.

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. Thank you Amma, Appa, Anika. ಹೊಸ ವರ್ಷ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
choices.translit: namaskāra. thank you Amma, Appa, Anika. hosa varṣa oḷḷeyadu.
choices.en: Hello. Thank you, Amma, Appa, Anika. Good new year.
Hi everyone. Thanks for having me. Happy Ugadi.

beats.native: ಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇಷ್ಟು speech. ನನ್ನ ಸಹೋದರ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ವರ್ಷ Bangalore ನಲ್ಲಿ — ಒಂದು sentence Kannada ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ accent ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ heavy — ಆದರೆ ಧೈರ್ಯ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು. ಸ್ವಾಗತ ತಮ್ಮ.
beats.translit: mūru tiṅgaḷalli iṣṭu speech. nanna sahōdara ippattu varṣa Bangalore-nalli — ondu sentence Kannada illa. nimma accent svalpa heavy — ādare dhairya oḷḷeyadu. svāgata tamma.
beats.en: This much speech in three months. My brother's been in Bangalore twenty years — not one sentence of Kannada. Your accent is a little heavy — but the bravery is good. Welcome, son.
beats.beat: tamma. son. the room hears it. amma's eyes are wet but she's pouring the next coffee.
